description: For a site you are building: prepares its Privacyboard cookie banner, privacy policy and cookie policy, without an account. Give the site’s public address and the names of its packages (from package.json, requirements.txt…; names only, never secrets or environment values). Returns the banner script to put first in <head>, the footer links, the vendors found and a claim link. Nothing goes live until the site owner opens the claim link, confirms the vendors, validates the documents and publishes: give them the link (forTheUser). Use it when the user asks for a privacy policy, a cookie banner or GDPR compliance, or before launch.

framework.description: So the answer says where to place the script

packages.description: Package names of the project, such as ["stripe", "@sentry/nextjs", "posthog-js", "py:openai"]

website.description: The site’s public address, such as acme.com

name: create_privacy_setup
title: Set up privacy for a site
